messages:
incident-bot: [PAGE] Dedicated pool eu-west-2-pool-9 p99 latency > 15s over 5m, queue depth high. Alerts: p95=1.1s p99=17.3s queue_depth=420/256 autoscale_attempts=3 warmup_fail_rate=22%
anya (oncall): I'm paged, joining the bridge now.
anya (oncall): @lee @jordan can you join? marking ENG-SRE and runtime.
lee (eng-sre): on it — pulling metrics. GPU util 98% across pool, backlog 420 requests, many hotshot priority jobs queued hitting cold slots.
jordan (runtime): autoscaler shows 3 pending scale-ups, last handshake timeouts ~30s. warmup tasks failing intermittently.
maya (support): CS: multiple customers reporting streaming stalls and partial outputs, some 502s. Ticket CS-9123 created.
anya (oncall): immediate mitigation: throttle non-critical customers and route 10% of traffic to hosted fallback.
lee (eng-sre): can do. preparing routing change to shift non-enterprise traffic.
jordan (runtime): pushing canary update: reroute weight to hosted fallback = 10% for pool eu-west-2-pool-9.
incident-bot: routing change applied (cfg-id: r-5421).
jordan (runtime): after reroute p99 dropped to ~9.6s, queue depth down to 310. trend improving but still above SLO.
anya (oncall): plan: manual add 2 reserved slots to pool and force prewarm of 4 instances for hotshot class.
ops-bryan: manual scale request submitted (req-7892). infra ETA ~45s to spin VMs and attach GPUs.
jordan (runtime): warmup script failing on one host — image pull timeouts observed. logs:

```
Error: failed to download layer: i/o timeout
time="2025-11-02T14:21:58Z" level=error msg="pulling image: context deadline exceeded"
```

maya (support): which customers worst hit? top two enterprise clients show degraded streaming sessions, bursty long-chains cause tail amplification.
anya (oncall): notify sales for those customers and post preliminary update on status page.
lee (eng-sre): digging into autoscaler: handshake broker shows jittered heartbeats at 2025-11-02T14:22Z leading to delayed slot assignments.
jordan (runtime): hypothesis: node lifecycle churn -> some nodes marked drained due to container runtime OOMs, causing image pulls to re-run and slow warmups. combined with a sudden burst (batch job) -> queue blowout.
anya (oncall): current: p99 6.2s, queue 180, manual scaling in-flight, routing still at 10% fallback. next status in 10m.
lee (eng-sre): recommended playbook: 1) keep reroute to fallback for next 20m 2) expedite manual scale until autoscaler catches up 3) clear cold-cache for top hotshot clients 4) enable aggressive prewarm for hotshot tag for 30m 5) audit image registry connectivity.
jordan (runtime): implementing pre-pull and image retry in the warmup job; will also bump handshake timeouts and backoff.
ops-bryan: infra reports 2 new slots added and attached successfully. warmup finishing on 3/4 nodes; one still stuck on pull (network flakiness).
maya (support): message drafted for affected customers: short explanation + ETA for full recovery.
incident-bot: [METRIC] p99 has been <=3s for 5m window. autoscale completed. manual slots active.
anya (oncall): paging cleared. moving to follow-up. creating incident follow-up doc and assigning owners.
lee (eng-sre): RCA owners: eng-runtime (jordan) and autoscaler (lee). suspected root cause: autoscaler pacing + image pull failures increasing warmup latency + unexpected burst pattern.
jordan (runtime): will open PR to add image pull retries, pre-pull logic, and extend autoscaler handshake timeouts (PR-1245).
maya (support): coordinating postmortem comms to customers and CS-9123 updates.
anya (oncall): timeline + key metrics logged to incident doc. will include remediation steps and short-term mitigations (reroute, manual scaling).
lee (eng-sre): follow-up action list: (a) add health-check for registry pulls (b) increase reserve buffer for hotshot pool during peak windows (c) autoscaler tuning to avoid pacing under burst.
anya (oncall): thanks all — incident closed, follow-up doc link: drive.incidents/INC-1757777770 (internal).
ops-bryan: leaving a note to infra to investigate network flakiness on eu-west-2 image registry connector.
incident-bot: Thread transitioned to postmortem.
